verification.method: Representative validation labels assigned by comparing stored Metadata Extraction outputs with the independently transcribed metadata ground truth and reviewed source limitations. Validator output was not used to assign expected labels.
verification.coverage: Seven documents cover a clean extraction, semantic BE/CE year equivalence, missing English source text, student-pairing ambiguity, advisor/co-advisor conflict, title boundary errors, academic-field errors, and keyword splitting errors.
verification.status_policy: A structurally plausible extraction mismatch is REVIEW_REQUIRED unless the supplied value is demonstrably malformed. Missing unavailable language-specific source text is MISSING at field level and REVIEW_REQUIRED at document level. No reliable INVALID document example exists in this subset.

document_009.known_issue: No metadata ground-truth mismatch; bilingual academic/advisor strings are correct translations but cannot be proven equivalent without authoritative reference aliases.

document_022.known_issue: Known corrupted Thai source causes several plausible-looking but incorrect extracted fields.

document_064.known_issue: English page has no stored OCR output for offline processing; Thai page remains usable.

document_137.known_issue: Thai title boundary/spacing and co-advisor selection differ from human-reviewed metadata.

document_266.known_issue: Selected CE year is semantically equivalent to the expected BE year; keyword item boundaries remain incorrect.

document_295.known_issue: An incomplete student candidate is retained and degree/department differ from reviewed metadata.

document_007.known_issue: Keyword splitting differs from explicitly separated human-reviewed items.
